subject.title: [Refactor] Consolidate synthetic log formats across MCP service pipelines

question: Should synthetic diagnostics from these two MCP pipelines be byte-identical apart from an explicit service identifier, or remain owner-specific implementation details?
rationale: Source similarity alone cannot determine whether diagnostic wording and fatal-error presentation are a shared operator contract or intentionally owned by each pipeline.

options.title: Keep owner-specific callbacks
options.body: Retain the local formatters unless a concrete user, tooling, or support requirement demonstrates that diagnostic drift is harmful.

options.title: Define a shared diagnostics contract
options.body: Approve an owner-neutral formatter with explicit service identity while preserving pipeline-specific error and lifecycle decisions at each caller.

recommendation.title: Keep owner-specific callbacks
recommendation.body: Retain the local formatters unless a concrete user, tooling, or support requirement demonstrates that diagnostic drift is harmful.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged work introduced the relevant MCP service infrastructure, and the issue timeline shows they were directly brought into this discussion.
